status: Applied to derived app curves; original samples preserved
method: impliedTorqueNm = recordedHp * 7120.9092 / rpm; adjustedTorqueNm = (recordedTorqueNm + impliedTorqueNm) / 2; calculatedHp = adjustedTorqueNm * rpm / 7120.9092. Between samples, interpolate adjusted torque and derive HP from torque and RPM.
percentBaseline: Each percentage uses its recorded value as denominator. Conservative review flags cover any raw torque discrepancy, averaged torque adjustment, or resulting horsepower adjustment over 5%. Intermediate HP is compared with the previous linear-HP curve at 1 RPM intervals.
display: Three significant figures; full-precision original and calculated values are retained in this JSON.
